book.name: LUK
book.title: LUK God so ok-ihey Luk hiy ma mey hok non

content: Jisas se ouon-aw lokin kwor e ma lonsan hom non
Juda mo hokruw enekwei aiopey hay ihey mo naw, yis lopa me la ey hokwe, pa ohriar lwak. Enekwei sohokwe Pasova ok me.
Pris karmay o, Juda mo sow ke hiymon-sorasor uwr o, homkwe uwrsa me hok, sa homkwe yerki Jisas se ouon-aw lokin kwor ey se sehe pawk.
Sei, Satan hiy Judas, Iskariot ok ma me, so uron mon kiynuw-yawriy. Hiykwe ki-wayh iha seys mu nareys-ar sohom mo uwr prueyn hiy non.
Judas Iskariot hiykwe ley nok, pris karmay o, God so a pekney-weys se hiy-wayr sosor uwr o, hme nion non-ohruw-a, yerki, hiy Jisas se hmo iha mon kow ey se.
Uwr somokwe hyo ok ke lonuayk menkin, homkwe kar ley. Sa homkwe hye mein-owon non nakway e me-loray.
Judas hiykwe hmo ok me uron kamon-aw non-wak. Sa hiykwe enekwei hiy yaprue ma lira, Jisas se hmo iha mon kow ey se lwak ira kraipakrai.
Jisas so ki-wayh prueysyar hohkwe Pasova-ayay ley unay-a koruay
Enekwei aiopey hay ihey mo naw, yis lopa me la ey, hiy pa lousne. Enekwei sohokwe sipsip-ney, Pasova enekwei so la ey me lokin kwor ey hiy non.
Jisas hiy Pita, Jon leys se me-ha nok, kiy-nak-me-sorasor kow ha, “Hohkwe ley nok, Pasova-ayay hrom la ey me kwa lunay-a koruay.”
Hoh hye mesopok, “Hai, hunkwe hror perey lunay-a koruay e mon o?”
Hiy lonuayk me, “Hoh taun mon lyawriy nonaw, uwr prueyn, yiawk aiopey hay hu non se ma nak-way nakey hiykwe hehe lonyay ey. Hohkwe hye pyay ha nok, a hiy ma lyawriy serey non-yawriy.
Hohkwe a-yiaup-uwr sohokwe senkin kwa mekow, ‘Hiymon sorasor uwr hiykwe hne senkin mesopok, ampok ha hano ki-wayh me nion Pasova-ayay me non-iwak sir a ey hokwe, poho?’
Sa hiykwe hehekwe ampok aiopey hay eir mon ma lwak se mesair kow ey. Ampok sohokwe po lonhan onhan koruay, seyr po huwhay koruay. Hohkwe ayay serey kwa lunay-a kekie sowkriy.”
Hoh non-ey nok, lira, omeme lowpwarowp mokwe, Jisas hiy ma mekow ha senkin lwak. Hohkwe sa ayay mokwe a serey sehe non-unay-a koruay.
Ayay, Hakamay so owhi o, nioh o, seme ma memeir hom non
Ay la enekwei lwak menkin, Jisas o, hyo ki-wayh o, homkwe tebol mon liwak sir.
Jisas hiy hyo ki-wayh me kiy-me, “Hano uron ipey-ar hokwe senkin nuw-wak, ha aw nak-ok lopa non kokwe, hakwe peyr Pasova-ayay eme hme nion non-a e nuw-mon.
Hakwe hme senkin mekow, hakwe ayay omokwe liy ma-la ley, ayay sohom mo meyk-ar hok God so Wayr-hre-yier mon lousne hra-hra ha sehe.”
Sei, Jisas hiykwe yiawk wain-hu non se nakway nok, God se nak-me-ihey nok, senkin kiy-nak-me, “Homkwe wain-hu ehe nakway nok, homkiaw-ayay nakway owndiy owswa.
Hakwe hme senkin kiy-mekow, hakwe wain-hu ohokwe liy ma-lowswa ley, God so Wayr-hre-yier hiy le sehe.”

Sei, hiykwe ihey mo naw imon lonok nok, God se manak-me-ihey nok, kamane nok, hyo ki-wayh me lowndiy. Hiy hme kiynak-me, “Okukwe hano owhi, hme ma kow hok non. Hane ma-nanpanan ey hokwe, homkwe yor sokukwe senkin-awaw kwa meio wayr-wayr.”

Hom ihey mo naw ke la lowpway menkin, hiykwe liy-liy-aw ma-lon, wain-hu se nakway nok, me, “Yiawk ohokwe God so sokior-ok iwon, hano nioh non ma me-sakon kawk hok non. Nioh sohokwe hme hokuaw ma swanon sow kow hiy non.
Sawk kwa lira, uwr hane ma wei kow hiykwe, ehe, hane nion tebol mon kiy-non-wak.
Uwrsa mo Ney hiykwe ya lokrue a, God hiykiaw ma me-sakon kawk senkin. Sawk uwr hye ma wei kow hiykwe piap lwak ey.”
Sei, hyo ki-wayh homkwe sa pau homkiaw-ayay-aw kiy-mesopok sopok, yor sokukwe ya hmo prueyn pohiy nuw-meio a-ney.
Uwr peyrmawk liarok uwr posokwaw lwak ey so?
Seyr homkwe hmo prueyn peyrmawk liarok uwr posokwaw lwak e, seme lon-seyrpaseyr ohruw-a.
Jisas hiy hme kiy-me, “Haiden mo king homkwe hmo uwrsa mo eir mon lwak, seyr makwey-uwr, uwrsa me hmo hiy-wayr krai me ma mesair kow homkwe homkiaw-ayay ‘Uwrsa mo wayh’ ok me.
Sawk homkwe senkin peie lwak o. Hmo prueyn seirpey-ar ma lwak hiykwe peyr nay-ih ineyr se hieyn kwa lwak. Seyr hmo prueyn hiy-wayr kraiay ey hiykwe peyr mey-uwr se hieyn kwa lwak.

Hai, uwr peyrmawk ma liarok hokwe pohiy non so? Uwr, ayay ma liwak-a hiy pak, uwr, ayay, hye ma morue hiy non pak? Uwr peyrmawk ma liarok hokwe, uwr ayay ma liwak-a sohiy non. Sawk hakwe hmo ompok mon kokwe uwr, ayay ma morue se hieyn kiy-wak.
Leykawn lowpwarowp hano mon ma lousne mokwe, homkwe hane nion siraw non-wak.
Sa hano Aio hiy hane uru, hiy-wayr kraiay ey se po kow, hakwe seyr hme uru liy-liy-aw sehe kow ey.
Homkwe ayay o, hu o, hano tebol mon liwak sir a ey, hano Wayr-hre-yier mon. Homkwe sia-king mon liwak sir ey, Israel mo uwrku iha seys me lira mesor anon anon ey hokwe.”
Pita hiy Jisas se nonkway lopa-ok ma me hiy non
Sa Jisas hiykwe senkin me, “Saimon, Saimon, kwa lonuayk. Satan hiykwe po mesopok, hme lowpwarowp mon ir ey hokwe, wit-i mo nam me hieyn mon-say ey.
Saimon, hakwe hne God se papo hiy-mesopok, hno nan kiykiy-ay yor hok makuayk lopa lwak ey hokwe. Sawk hwon ma-kankoum ne ankin, hunkwe hno wayh me kwa hiy-mon kraipakrai.”
Pita hiy lonuayk me, “Hakamay, hakwe hne nion kalabus-a mon liy non-ey, seyr hne nion liy non-okrue.”
Sa Jisas hiy kiy-me, “Pita, hakwe hne senkin mekow, pokon arawh kokwe, kakaruk hiy me lopa non kokwe, hunkwe enekwei krompri hane nonkway-lopa-ok senkin me ey.”
Jisas hiy mekow, weynpaweyn piap-araw ki-wayh mo owh mon lousne ey
Sei, Jisas hiy hyo ki-wayh me kiy-mesopok, “Enekwei, ha hme owk-neyp o, meyki-owk o, sune-ohi o, sohom lopa ma me-ha, homkwe omeme kamon ohna pankaw lwak?” Hom lonuayk me, “Korey.”

Hiykwe hme me, “Sawk pokon enkin kokwe, uwr prueyn owk-neyp non posokwaw lwak e, meyki-owk non posokwaw lwak e, kwa huor nok. Seyr aw-seik lopa posokwaw lwak e, hiykwe hyo saket ke isay nakway nok, aw-seik nakway.

Hakwe hme senkin mekow, God so mamey senkin ma me, ‘Uwrsa homkwe hyekwe uwr piap-araw me nion nak-sor peykyay’, ok sokukwe hano mon ok-ar lousne hrahra ha ey, payhokuaw ok hane ma mey mokwe, pau ok-ar kiy-ousne sa-ousne.” Ais 53:12
Ki-wayh hom me, “Hakamay, hwon seyn lira, aw-seik pireys-ar kokwe, okwe.” Hiy lonuayk me, “Ok somokwe sopiaw.”
Jisas hiykwe God se mnuw Oliv mon ley mesopok
Jisas hiy Jerusalem se lokriy hain nok, ley, mnuw Oliv mon. Hyo yor sokukwe mo senkinaw-aw lon. Seyr hyo ki-wayh homkwe hye pyay ha.
Hiy yier serey hiy-ousne menkin, hme kiy-me, “Homkwe God se sehe mesopok e, sa homkwe leykawn mon makuayk sa-kuayk pa ka lwak.”
Hiykwe hme serey lokriy hain nok, sa mein se ma ka-sasow ha, meiaw eyn senkin kakor-ey popor nok, pamuow kampueys nok, mesopok,
“Aio, hno uron ko lwak ankin, hunkwe aw nak-ok yiawk hano mon ma lwak ehe kwa lonok nakey. Sawk hunkwe hano uron ko so meyki peie pyay o. Hunkwe hno uron ko so meyki kwa pyay.”
Sa ensel prueyn nonkumey ko hiy laye nok, hye hiy-mon kraipakrai.
Jisas hiykwe uron nuw-kuw kworpakwor kawk, hyo owh hiy low ma nuw-hei se. Sa hiykwe God se aiopey hay sehe nuw-mesopok. Hyo kruayk mokwe nioh me hieyn ki mon eysay eysay.
Hiy mesopok lowpway nok, ma-ley, hyo ki-wayh mo owh mon. Hiy sa hom anwaw lwon sowkway me ka-ira ne. Payhokuaw, homkwe uron nuw-kuw kworpakwor kreik.
Hiy hme me, “Hai, homkwe anwaw panoke war-won o? Homkwe loksian-sasian mesopok e, God se, sa homkwe leykawn mon makuayk sakuayk lopa ka lwak.”
Jisas se aw-uwr hom ma nekie hiy non
Jisas hiy ok lohruw-a nonaw, sa uwr orhey non hom le. Judas, ki-wayh mo prueyn hiykiaw peyr. Hiykwe sa Jisas se way neyr-a-neyr e le.
Sawk Jisas hiy kiy-mesopok, “Judas, hmey, hunkwe Uwrsa mo Ney se kokwe nak-way neyr-a-neyr non uwr piap-araw mo iha mon kow ey so?”
Jisas so ki-wayh hom weynpaweyn penkin hom lousne ey se lira menkin, homkwe hye mesopok, “Hakamay, hromkwe hromo aw-seik non liy lono o?”
Sa hmo uwr prueyn hiykwe Pris Makwey-uwr so mey-uwr so nweyk ke lokian pru sow.
Sawk Jisas hiy lonuayk me, “Weynpaweyn sokukwe sopiaw.” Sa hiykwe uwr sohiy so nweyk ke sapou mon popriy kow.

Sa Jisas hiykwe pris karmay o, God so a pekney-weys se hiy-wayr sosor uwr o, Juda mo hakamay o, hye nekie e ma le-nene seme kiy-me, “Hmey, hakwe sow me kamaun sow uwr so, hom hane aw-seik o, aw-now o, sohom non ma nake ohokwe?
Eypok lowpwarowp mokwe hakwe mo hme nion God so a pekney-weys mon non-wak, sa homkwe hane pase nekie e. Sawk aua ohokwe, hmo; eym-nawp so krai hiy ma hiy-wayr ohokwe.”
Pita hiy Jisas se nonkway lopa ok ma me hiy non
Homkwe Jisas se nekie nok, hiy-ey, sa Pris Makwey-uwr so a mon hiy-yawriy. Pita hiykwe mei-aw mei-aw lonsu ney.
Ya kamon kokwe a-yier ompok mon lunay, sa Pita hiykwe unsaney serey ma kikrweik awndiy me nion non-wakiawkeyn.
Mey-sa prueyn hokwe sa Pita hiy ya mon wakiawkeyn se lira. Hokwe hye nuw-ira kraipakrai nok, kiynuw-me, “Uwr ohokwe, Jisas se nion ma non-wak hiy non.”
Sawk Pita hiykwe nak-meyamey, “Akwa, hakwe uwr sohokwe nonkway lwak pey.”
Kiykor-wak popor ha menkin, sa uwr prueyn hiy hye lira nok, me, “Hwon seyn, hunkwe hmo prueyn.” Pita hiy lonuayk me, “Ara, ha korey.”
Aua kamon ley lowpway menkin, uwr prueyn hiy hye ma-me, “Me kama, uwr ohokwe mo hye nion non-wak, payhokuaw, hiykwe Galili-uwr.”
Sawk Pita hiy lonuayk me, “Ara, hakwe ok hwon ma lohruw-a somokwe nonkway lwak pey.” Hiy senkin me nonaw, kakaruk hiy pa ok kiynuw-me.

Hakamay hiy swahre nok, Pita se nuw-ira. Pita hiykwe sa ok Jisas hye ma lohruw-a kow me ma-nanpanan. Jisas hiykwe Pita se kokwe senkin mekow. “Pokon arawh kokwe kakaruk hiy ok me lopa non kokwe, hunkwe enekwei krompri hane nonkway-lopa-ok senkin me ey.”
Pita hiykwe sa ki apau mon ley nok, eheyr aiopey hay nuw-yuk.
Jisas se ma lourde omniy mamniy hiy non
Uwr, Jisas se ma liarok ira kraipakrai homkwe, hye lourde nok, nak-omniy.
Homkwe Jisas so nene me nak-ok sapeykyay kopyo nok, nak-mesopok, “Hne posokwaw lomniy so? Hunkwe profet-ok kwa me.”
Seyr homkwe hye ok piap-ok kraiar senkin nak-me.
Jisas se kokwe Juda mo kaunsil mo inour mon hiy-ey
Enekwei ey hiy ka-kaie nerie menkin, Juda mo kaunsil homkwe suhway-aw senkin nuw-hokruw, pris karmay o, sow ke hiymon-sorasor uwr o. Sa Jisas se kokwe hmo inour mon sehe hiy-ey.
Hom Jisas se mesopok, “Hunkwe Krais lwak ankin, hreme kwa mekow.” Hiy lonuayk me, “Ha hme mekow ankin, homkwe hano ok me liy nanpanan kiykiy-ay ley.
Sa ha hme mesopok ankin, homkwe liy lonuayk me ley.
Sawk pokon enekwei ohiy o, yaw o, senkin-awaw, Uwrsa mo Ney hiykwe God Seirpey-ar so iha sayar mon liwak ey.”
Uwr lowpwarowp sohom me, “Hmey, hunkwe God so Ney so?” Hiy hme lonuayk me, “Mo sehe, homkiaw ma kiy-me se.”
Sei, hom me, “Hromkwe uwr har mo woki-ok mokwe sankaw liy ma-lonuayk ley. Hromkwe ok, hiy ma me mokwe, hromkiaw po kiy-onuayk.”
